authorization.scope: Continue the pre-existing clean-surface odd-layer convergence ladder prospectively, beginning at L19, without retroactively changing the L17 HOLD or any frozen threshold.

rung_rule.source_for_each_new_rung: Immediately preceding mechanically valid relaxed and independently reproduced rung
rung_rule.initialization: Transfer only the symmetric z relaxation offsets of the outer two layers on each face from the immediately preceding rung onto an otherwise ideal target slab. Energies and pass/fail outcomes may not alter the seed.

continuation_logic.close_ladder_when: The target rung passes force, independent-SCF reproduction, and the unchanged adjacent-rung 1 meV/surface-atom surface-excess gate.
continuation_logic.continue_to_next_rung_when: The target rung is mechanically valid, relaxation and independent-SCF reproduction pass, but only the unchanged adjacent-rung surface-excess gate remains above 0.001 eV/surface atom.
stop_for_scientific_review_when: force gate fails after a completed relaxation
independent fixed-geometry SCF reproduction gate fails
the target cannot complete relaxation or SCF inside its frozen restart runway
provenance, symmetry, method, or hash verification fails
